en: WASD/click: move  E: use  Stand behind the register to serve
zh: WASD/点击：移动  E：交互  站在收银台后自动结账

en: Order before opening or after closing: paid now, delivered before the next opening.
zh: 开店前或打烊后都能下单：下单即付款，下次开店前送到。

en: Pick what each slot holds; restocking keeps it full.
zh: 给每一格选商品，补货会自动补满。

en: No staff can be hired yet.
Click to place or select. R: rotate. Right-click: cancel.
zh: 点击摆放或选中，R 旋转，右键取消。

en: No storage that can hold that.
zh: 没有能放这种货的仓库。
不能拆掉最后一个门口。
已订的货需要放在这里。

en: That shelf can't keep this product.
zh: 这个货架放不了这种商品。

en: Stand in front of it first.
That save could not be loaded.
Carrying {qty} {product} to {fixture} slot {n} (E at storage to put back)
zh: 搬着 {qty} 件{product} → {fixture}第 {n} 格（在仓库按 E 可放回）

en: Carrying {product} to the {fixture} (E at cold storage to put back)
zh: 搬着{product} → {fixture}（在冷库按 E 可放回）

en: Steamed fish with ginger and scallion
That dish is sold at a different station.
zh: 这道菜要在另一种档口卖。

en: That is only for the kitchen.
Before opening choose a dish and today's target for each station slot. Short of ingredients the kitchen cooks until they run out.
zh: 开店前为每个档口格子选一道菜和今天的目标份数。原料不够时，做到用完为止。

en: No steam table or roast station yet.
zh: 还没有打菜台或烧腊档。

en: Dishes and what is in stock
That has to go against a wall.
Nothing is on order yet. Start the next day anyway?
zh: 还没进货，要进入下一天吗？

en: {per_slot} per slot · have {stock} (+{pending}) · last day {sold} · fits {room} more
zh: 一格 {per_slot} 个 · 现有 {stock}（+{pending}） · 上一天卖 {sold} · 还能放 {room}

en: Only a manager can run a department.

zh: 今天的班次（上午 | 下午）
任务优先级（数字大的先做）

en: Morale: wage {wage}, work {work} (days in a row {streak}, tasks today {tasks})
zh: 士气：工资 {wage}，工作 {work}（连续上班 {streak} 天，今天做了 {tasks} 件）

en: {days} days to the Spring Festival: stock up on mandarins, candy boxes, red envelopes and nian gao.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是春节，记得准备年桔、糖果盒、红包和年糕。

en: {days} days to the Dragon Boat Festival: stock up on zongzi and glutinous rice.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是端午节，记得准备粽子和糯米。

en: {days} days to the Mid-Autumn Festival: remember the mooncakes!
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是中秋节，记得准备月饼！

en: {days} days to Thanksgiving: more shoppers will want deli food, snacks and drinks.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是感恩节，熟食、零食和饮料会更好卖。

en: {days} days to Christmas: more shoppers will want deli food, snacks and drinks.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是圣诞节，熟食、零食和饮料会更好卖。

en: Making zongzi at home this year.
The moon will be so round tonight.
The supplier will have no {product} from {start} to {end}. Stock up now!
zh: 供应商{start}到{end}没有{product}，赶紧囤货吧！

en: Wholesale prices for {department} go up {percent}% from {start} to {end}.
A hygiene inspector visits today around {time}: no spoiled goods on display, clean tank water, tidy produce stands.
zh: 今天 {time} 左右卫生检查员会来：货架上不能有坏货，鱼池水要干净，果蔬架要整齐。

en: Power cut today from {start} to {end}: chilled goods spoil faster and tank water fouls quickly.
zh: 今天 {start} 到 {end} 停电：冷藏商品坏得更快，鱼池水质下降更快。

en: Rain all day: fewer shoppers today.
zh: 今天一整天下雨，顾客会少一些。

en: A food influencer is coming today! Expect crowds after snacks and deli food.
zh: 今天有网红来打卡！会有很多人来买零食和熟食。

en: A supplier offers {qty} {product} near expiry (sell by {date}) for {cost} in all.
zh: 供应商低价推销 {qty} 件临期{product}（{date}前要卖掉），一共 {cost}。

en: A regular wants {goods} to collect tomorrow at {time}, and will pay {reward}.
zh: 老顾客想订 {goods}，明天 {time} 来取，付 {reward}。

en: The wholesaler only has that in the days before its festival.
zh: 这个只在节前一段时间才能进货。

en: The supplier is out of that right now.
No free spot on the wall there.

zh: 今天：{season}季{day}日 周{weekday}（第 {n} 天）

en: Red: festival day · pink: prep days · gold: today
zh: 红色：节日 · 粉色：准备期 · 金色：今天

en: Order festival goods from {date} until the day before.
zh: 节日商品从{date}起可以进货，到节前一天为止。

en: Power cut! Chilled goods are spoiling.
zh: 停电了！冷藏商品在变质。

en: Power cut: the generator keeps everything running.
zh: 停电了，发电机保证一切正常运转。

en: Not enough stock: the group order was missed.
